items.title: Company Reputation Check Before a Job Offer
items.pt:
The decision in brief


A company reputation check should help you decide whether the employer's public identity matches the opportunity being offered.


Review the employer's official website, professional profiles, directories, social platforms, publishing platforms, and search results.
Compare the same basic facts across sources: company name, location, services, leadership, industry, and official contact details.
Separate ordinary criticism from signs of inaccurate information, impersonation

items.title: WorldSculpt: Generating Compositional Worlds from Grounded Videos
items.pt: We study the problem of generating a compositional 3D representation of a cluttered scene containing hundreds of objects. The goal is to represent the scene as a collection of individual object meshes placed in a shared world frame, as required by downstream applications such as gaming, AR/VR, simulation, and robotics. items.title: WearableQA: A Benchmark for Health Reasoning over Real-World Wearable Data
items.pt: Recent advances in wearable sensing enable continuous monitoring of physiological and behavioral signals, yet existing benchmarks rarely evaluate whether AI systems can reason over a real user's longitudinal wearable record. items.title: Same Trajectory, Contradictory Rewards (ROBORMBENCH): Paraphrase Fragility in Vision Language Reward Models
items.pt: Vision-language models are increasingly used as reward functions for robotic learning, but this role requires paraphrase invariance: the same trajectory should receive the same reward under semantically equivalent goal descriptions.
